FRONTEND 2/2 GREEN — /auto/vehicle/1f49c4c5-... renders PaymentTermsBanner (data-testid=payment-terms-banner) between PriceGuidance(Y=470) and EngagementPanel(Y=1392) (bannerY=1014); all 4 sub-sections present (deposit-base mentions NZ$20,000, tier1 mentions 20%, tier2 mentions 30%+NZ$40,000, window mentions 24 часов); per-vehicle highlight payment-terms-this-vehicle-tier1 shows «Для этого лота — NZ$4,900». Base-tier lot 129ff37c-... renders all 4 sections but per-vehicle tier1/tier2 highlights are absent (correct). REGRESSION 2/2 GREEN — /auto/catalog «Найдено: 1602» (≥1000 ✅), /auto/auctions has 58 data-testid=auction-link-* anchors all internal (/auto/auctions/event/...), 0 external hrefs, 0 target=_blank (iter14 fix intact).

minor.issue: Spec example used the Hilux SR5 to exercise the 403 deposit-gate, but in current seed data this vehicle is country=AU + listing_type=inquiry_only — so place_bid() rejects with HTTP 400 ('Ставки доступны только для автомобилей из Новой Зеландии.') BEFORE the deposit gate runs. The deposit gate itself works correctly when tested against an NZ auction tier1 vehicle (verified). Recommend either re-seeding the Hilux as country=NZ + listing_type=auction for demo realism, or updating future spec examples to point at an NZ auction lot.

action_items: Consider re-seeding the demo Hilux SR5 (1f49c4c5-4f6a-44d8-a1fa-d6ff43579a88) to country=NZ + listing_type=auction so the bid-deposit gate can be demoed on it as the spec described — currently the country=AU + inquiry_only flags trip the pre-deposit guards first.
Optional: surface payment_terms_summary().version in the admin settings page so changes to the disclosure can be audited.
critical_code_review_comments: services/auto_service.py place_bid — ordering of validation guards: country/listing_type/status checks run BEFORE the deposit-amount check. That is correct defence-in-depth, but it means any test that wants to exercise the 403 deposit-gate must first pick a country=NZ + listing_type=auction + status=available vehicle. Worth documenting in the docstring.

services/auto_payment_terms.py — reference_price_nzd() falls back to ai_estimate.recommended_max_bid_nzd when current_price_nzd is zero. This can silently push a $0-priced fresh-import into tier1/tier2 if the AI estimator returns a high number. Consider gating the AI-estimate fallback behind a 'has_real_price' flag, or at least logging when AI is used to derive deposit tier.

routes/auto_routes.py /vehicles/{id}/deposit-required — exposes user_meets_requirement and user_verified_amount_nzd to any authenticated user. For privacy, double-check the docstring spec; currently OK because it only echoes the caller's own balance, but worth a quick review to confirm no leakage of other users' deposit state.

PaymentTermsBanner.jsx — calls autoApi.get('/payment-terms') on every mount of the vehicle detail page with no client-side cache; for a static disclosure block this is wasteful. Recommend memoising the response in a React context or localStorage with a short TTL.
